analysis.secondary_multiplicity: Holm-adjusted when inferential p-values are reported; otherwise descriptive and explicitly exploratory
analysis.ties: deterministic month-number tie break for ranked lists; average ranks for Spearman; Kendall tau-b tie correction

decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE: fewer than 60 complete queries OR fewer than 15 independent clusters OR incomplete verified adjudication
decision_rule.NO_ESTABLISHED_IMPROVEMENT: minimum data met but supported-improvement rule is not met
decision_rule.SUPPORTED_IMPROVEMENT: minimum data met AND paired mean difference >= 0.01 AND cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

power_statement: The target is feasibility-based; no guaranteed statistical power is claimed. Precision depends on realized labels and effective climate-source clusters.
primary_question: Does the frozen original activity-aware seasonality model improve monthly attraction-activity ranking over the frozen district multivariable reference on a new independently judged dataset?
